daily_thesis: 8월 12일 배치는 로봇 시스템의 핵심 병목이 더 큰 모델이 아니라, 어떤 증거를 믿고 정책, 지도, 캐시, 메모리, 안전 판단을 갱신할지 정하는 문제로 이동했음을 보여준다. Semantic 3DGS grounding, Surgical WAM, FACT, VIScore, Gated VLA-Cache, estimator spectral analysis, AD2-Bench는 모두 최종 점수보다 update/reject/cache/retrieve/intervene 결정을 먼저 드러내야 한다고 말한다.

clusters.cluster: World-action models shift from plausible futures to failure-conditioned control
clusters.why: 기존 world model 평가는 그럴듯한 미래 영상을 만드는지에 머무르기 쉬웠지만, Surgical WAM과 FACT는 action-labeled budget, failure rollout, task progress가 실제 control decision을 바꾸는지 묻는다. VIScore와 4D-WAM은 latent quality와 4D consistency가 planning success와 연결되어야 한다고 압박한다. APRL 관점에서는 future prediction을 성능 proxy로 쓰기 전에 실패 action이 어떤 recovery decision을 바꿨는지 검증해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: WAM, driving WAM, planning latent metric, failure-aware memory papers가 같은 control-evidence 축에 모인다.
clusters.lab_action: 동일 manipulation 또는 driving replay에서 success-only WAM, failure-conditioned WAM, 4D-consistent WAM을 비교하고, task progress 예측이 실제 action 선택을 바꾸는 첫 시점을 측정한다.

clusters.cluster: VLA deployment needs attack-aware and uncertainty-gated action shortcuts
clusters.why: VLA 배포는 latency를 줄이는 동시에 action decision이 공격이나 불확실성에 흔들리는 순간을 알아야 한다. DURA는 자연스러운 diffusion patch로 action을 조작하고, Gated VLA-Cache는 action-token margin으로 cache를 무효화하며, SALT는 action latent가 언어적 의미를 잃는 문제를 제기한다. UniProbe와 SafeCap까지 합치면 배포 최적화는 빠르게 실행하는 문제가 아니라 언제 재계산하고 언제 action authority를 낮출지 정하는 문제다.
clusters.confidence_note: attack, cache, action tokenizer, hallucination detector, safety-caption papers가 모두 action-evidence boundary를 건드린다.
clusters.lab_action: VLA replay에서 자연스러운 distractor patch, object swap, motion blur, low-margin action token을 stress split으로 만들고 cache reuse, recompute, action drift, task failure를 함께 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Geometry becomes executable scene memory instead of visual reconstruction

clusters.cluster: Navigation safety shifts from geometric clearance to introspective risk signals

clusters.confidence_note: estimator, pose integrity, MPC monitor, risk planner, safety filter papers가 같은 runtime warning 축을 형성한다.
clusters.lab_action: 동일 navigation route에서 estimator spectrum, pose protection level, MPC multiplier stress, safety-filter activation을 동기화하고 false alarm budget을 맞춘 뒤 warning lead time과 recovery success를 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Long-horizon robots need revisable memory with explicit trust boundaries

strategy_board.title: Failure-conditioned world-action benchmark
strategy_board.thesis: Build a robot replay suite where successful and failed actions supervise future prediction, progress estimation, and recovery decisions.
strategy_board.one_week: Convert one manipulation or surgical-style dataset into success/failure action clips with progress labels and near-miss tags.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare vanilla WAM, FACT-style failure conditioning, and video-only pretraining under the same action-label budget.
strategy_board.success: Failure-conditioned prediction changes the selected action before task-level failure in at least two failure families.
strategy_board.stop: Failure labels improve offline prediction but do not alter recovery or success ranking.
strategy_board.asset: Failure rollouts, progress labels, counterfactual action clips, and recovery-decision tables.

strategy_board.title: Introspective deployment shortcut controller
strategy_board.thesis: Unify cache invalidation, estimator-health warning, protection-level bound, and MPC dual stress as stop conditions for fast robot deployment.
strategy_board.one_week: Instrument one navigation or VLA replay with action-token margin, estimator spectral score, pose bound, and safety multiplier traces.
strategy_board.four_week: Run stress tests where each shortcut is allowed or rejected, then measure latency, warning lead time, and downstream action error.
strategy_board.success: At least one introspection signal prevents a harmful shortcut before a standard metric flags failure.
strategy_board.stop: Signals are redundant with confidence or arrive after the unsafe action has already been chosen.
strategy_board.asset: Synchronized introspection traces, rejection labels, latency-risk curves, and intervention policies.

strategy_board.title: Evidence-chain robot memory protocol
strategy_board.thesis: Make semantic 3D maps, object-navigation beliefs, and urban-scene reasoning prove which evidence supports each action or map update.
strategy_board.one_week: Create paired scenes with target distractors, corrupted evidence regions, and reachability conflicts for map-to-action grounding.
strategy_board.four_week: Evaluate Semantic 3DGS grounding, AECNav-style evidence consolidation, and AD2/TAR-style reasoning traces by action change under evidence removal.
strategy_board.success: Evidence-chain quality predicts target choice, base placement, or hazard response better than final answer accuracy.
strategy_board.stop: Evidence traces improve explanation readability but do not predict control or navigation decisions.
strategy_board.asset: Evidence-corrupted scenes, 3D semantic maps, belief traces, target support labels, and action-change metrics.
